scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A convincing overlay
scenes.caption: A fictional call appears on the Decision Lab screen with an agency badge and formal language. The caller claims official authority over Aditi. Vihaan labels it a claim: the badge does not independently identify the caller.
scenes.speech: A fictional call appears on the Decision Lab screen with an agency badge and formal language. The caller claims official authority over Aditi. Vihaan labels it a claim: the badge does not independently identify the caller.
scenes.dialogue: A badge on screen is not verified authority.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: The urgency trap
scenes.caption: The caller adds a countdown and demands an immediate transfer to settle a supposed case. Their teacher keeps the classroom example calm and non-graphic. Aditi may pause whenever needed; nobody must remain in an upsetting conversation.
scenes.speech: The caller adds a countdown and demands an immediate transfer to settle a supposed case. Their teacher keeps the classroom example calm and non-graphic. Aditi may pause whenever needed; nobody must remain in an upsetting conversation.
scenes.dialogue: Pressure does not create an obligation to obey.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Close the support lanes
scenes.caption: The caller tells Aditi not to tell family or teachers and to remain visible on the call. Vihaan draws these instructions as arrows closing support routes. These coercive demands need not be obeyed before seeking help.
scenes.speech: The caller tells Aditi not to tell family or teachers and to remain visible on the call. Vihaan draws these instructions as arrows closing support routes. These coercive demands need not be obeyed before seeking help.
scenes.dialogue: You may leave and involve a trusted adult.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose independent help
scenes.caption: The learner ends the coercive call without transferring money or sharing a code. Aditi approaches the teacher through the ordinary classroom support route. They do not use the caller’s supplied number to verify that caller’s authority.
scenes.speech: The learner ends the coercive call without transferring money or sharing a code. Aditi approaches the teacher through the ordinary classroom support route. They do not use the caller’s supplied number to verify that caller’s authority.
scenes.dialogue: Leave the demand; open an independent route.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: The timer loses control
scenes.caption: The teacher opens a separately verified official reporting route and helps describe the incident. The countdown disappears: the caller cannot control access to help. This follows official warnings about agency impersonation and video-call isolation.
scenes.speech: The teacher opens a separately verified official reporting route and helps describe the incident. The countdown disappears: the caller cannot control access to help. This follows official warnings about agency impersonation and video-call isolation.
scenes.dialogue: Independent support is available without caller permission.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: A private factual note
scenes.caption: Vihaan preserves the supplied caller identifier, message wording and transfer demand privately with adult help. Nobody reopens the coercive call to gather better evidence. Their plan records events and help sought; the verified support process addresses identity.
scenes.speech: Vihaan preserves the supplied caller identifier, message wording and transfer demand privately with adult help. Nobody reopens the coercive call to gather better evidence. Their plan records events and help sought; the verified support process addresses identity.
scenes.dialogue: Relevant existing evidence is enough to seek help.
